newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's SFC disciplines brokerages, Kin Son director.
newsitem.headline: HK's SFC disciplines brokerages, Kin Son director.

text.p: Hong Kong market watchdog the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) said on Thursday it reprimanded two brokerages and some of their staff, and had sued a Kin Son Electronic (Holdings) Co Ltd director.

It reprimanded Golden Sea Securities Co Ltd, its dealing director Tsang Hing Chi and its dealer's representative Chan Suet Lin for failure to exercise adequate internal control, the watchdog said in a statement.

Under such failure, a staff member had been able to carry out trading malpractices that disadvantaged the company's clients, and four people had been allowed to act as the firm's representatives without being registered with the SFC.

The watchdog also reprimanded Yu On Securities Co Ltd and its dealing director Cheung Lo-yau for failing to implement proper internal control to ensure staff did not engage in short selling. Two of its staff members had been fined in June for short selling.

The SFC said it had successfully prosecuted on Wednesday Chau Shek-cheong, a non-executive director of Kin Son Electronic, for failing to notify the stock exchange of cessation of interests in 82.35 million Kin Son shares in May 1995.
He was fined HK$5,000 and ordered to pay costs of HK$13,303.
All directors and substantial shareholders of locally-listed companies are obliged to notify promptly the companies and the stock exchange of any change to their shareholding.
